summary: Iteration 84: Broker Execution Privileges - All features PASSED. Backend correctly restricts live trade execution to owner only (managingdirector@redslateholdings.com). Admin and regular users get read-only access. All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend BrokerConnect component correctly implements conditional rendering for mode badge and order buttons based on execution_allowed status.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend _is_execution_allowed() correctly checks user.role == 'owner' for execution privileges
GET /api/broker/execution-status returns {execution_allowed: true, mode: 'live'} for owner, {execution_allowed: false, mode: 'read_only'} for others
POST /api/broker/order/{broker_id} correctly returns 403 with 'restricted' message for non-owner users
DELETE /api/broker/order/{broker_id}/{order_id} correctly returns 403 for non-owner users
POST /api/broker/connect works for all authenticated users (no execution check on connect)
Read-only endpoints (account, positions, orders, portfolio-sync) remain accessible to all users
Frontend AccountDashboard fetches execution-status and sets canExecute state correctly
Mode badge (data-testid=broker-mode-badge) shows 'LIVE TRADING' (lime) for owner, 'READ ONLY' (amber) for others
New Order button (data-testid=broker-new-order-btn) only renders when canExecute=true
Cancel order button only renders when canExecute=true AND order is pending
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 84 verified broker execution privileges. Owner (role='owner') has live trading enabled (execution_allowed=true, mode='live'). All other users (admin, regular) have read-only access (execution_allowed=false, mode='read_only'). Backend endpoints: GET /api/broker/execution-status returns execution status, POST /api/broker/order/{broker_id} and DELETE /api/broker/order/{broker_id}/{order_id} return 403 for non-owners. Frontend: AccountDashboard component (inside BrokerConnect.jsx) shows mode badge (data-testid=broker-mode-badge) and conditionally renders New Order button (data-testid=broker-new-order-btn) and Cancel order buttons based on canExecute state. Note: Actual broker connection requires real API keys which we don't have in testing, so the AccountDashboard with mode badge can only be seen when a broker is connected.
